# ADR 0003: Explicit payment state machine with an append-only event history

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Payment gateway integration hub

## Context

Webhooks arrive late, twice and out of order; verification and reconciliation can race with them.

## Decision

Model statuses and legal transitions in one class; every change goes through it inside a transaction that locks the payment row and appends a payment_event. Illegal or backward transitions are ignored and logged.

## Consequences

Out-of-order events can't corrupt state; the history explains every status. More code than a status column.

## Alternatives considered

Updating the status column directly from each handler.
